name: Torbran
description: A red-bearded dwarf noble from Eldraine, Thane of the Red Fell clan, who wields a massive axe.

timeline.summary: Rankle inadvertently completes the trap just as the Phyrexians fall under the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: Rankle inadvertently brought the plan to fruition just as the Phyrexians fell under the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
timeline.quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Torbran tells Rankle the courts have fallen and that they must stand at Locthwain; Rankle sees this as a chance to reach Ayara.
timeline.quote: "The courts have fallen," the dwarf said in a quivery voice.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle transforms Torbran's ring into a caterpillar and steals it while he sleeps.
timeline.quote: The ring had transformed into a caterpillar.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle uses the ring to wish for a basket of cookies and then a love potion, refusing to return it.
timeline.quote: "I wish for a love potion!" Rankle interrupted.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
timeline.quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Torbran strikes the invading phalanx, leaving only ash.
timeline.quote: When the light faded, only ash remained around him.

citation.text: Fiery Emancipation (Wilds of Eldraine: Enchanting Tales, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dog of the New Phyrexian Invasion attacks Rankle and Torbran rescues him.
timeline.quote: He was rescued by Torbran , who was traveling to Locthwain.

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Locthwain, Rankle finds Ayara compleated and steals Torbran's ring of three wishes.
timeline.quote: Unfazed, he stole Torbran's ring of three wishes

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rankle's third wish rains love potion; the Phyrexians pursue him and fall into the chasm as the Wicked Slumber overtakes them.
timeline.quote: all the Phyrexians, affected by the love potion, pursued Rankle and fell into the chasm, just as the Wicked Slumber overtook them

citation.text: "Rankle", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Torbran travels to Embereth to compete for knighthood but refuses to strike the Irencrag and returns to the Wilds.

citation.text: "Torbran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: New Phyrexia invades Eldraine; Torbran escapes compleation and plans to attack Castle Locthwain.

citation.text: "Torbran", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Torbran rescues Rankle from a Phyrexian attack and takes him along.
timeline.quote: he rescued Rankle from a Phyrexian attack

citation.text: "Torbran", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rankle steals Torbran's wishing ring and wastes two wishes; his third wish, a rain of love potion, defeats the Phyrexian force.
timeline.quote: Rankle's third wish - a rain of love potion - ended up singlehandedly defeating the Phyrexian force

citation.text: "Torbran", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Torbran argues their kind must work together
relations.quote: Our kind is meant to work together.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Torbran fights the invaders and lays a trap for them
relations.quote: We have laid a trap for these monsters.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

relations.note: Torbran owns the ring; the page does not say who made it

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.
